title: Select Sector Indices conditional secondary reweighting — the quarter-end backstop that fires only if a cap is breached on 2027-12-30
source: EST: date derived by applying an SEC-filed rule to the 2027 calendar. SEC EDGAR, Select Sector SPDR Trust Form 497 (accession 0001193125-26-031948, d85739d497.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 2,388,335 bytes) and the secondary-reweighting sentence extracted verbatim: 'Additionally, if, on the second to last business day of March, June, September, or December a company has a weight greater than 24% or the sum of the companies with weights greater than 4.8% exceeds 50%, a secondary reweighting will be triggered with the reweighting effective date being after the close of the last business day of the month. This secondary reweighing will use the Select Sector Index constituent capped index weights as of the second to last business day of March, June, September, or December, utilizing the current additional weight factors and membership, shares outstanding, and investable weight factors as of the reweighting effective date.' Applied to December 2027: the month's weekdays end 12-27 (Mon), 12-28, 12-29, 12-30, 12-31 (Fri); the calendar's own canonical christmas-market-closure-2027-12-24.json records the ONE equity closure in the month (Christmas Day 2027-12-25 is a Saturday, observed Friday 2027-12-24, outside this window), and 2027-12-31 is tracked as a session, not a closure, by sifma-bond-early-close-2027-12-31 (an EARLY close for bonds, equities open) and by fed-board-closure-2027-12-31, whose federalreserve.gov K.8 source states the Federal Reserve Banks are OPEN that day and only the Board of Governors is closed. So the last business day of December 2027 is 2027-12-31 and the second-to-last is 2027-12-30. Filed estimate on the same counts as its March and June siblings: the filing dates the RULE, not this instance; no 2027-dated S&P DJI or SPDR schedule was fetched; and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the sp-rebalance-reference-close-2027-12-10 initial research (2026-09-09). The calendar already tracks this conditional backstop for 2026-09-30, 2026-12-31, 2027-03-31 and 2027-06-30 and stops there; 2027-12-31 is the quarter-end downstream of the event this proposer researches and was simply missing. WHY IT MATTERS TO THE PROPOSER: the proposer's own load-bearing measurement is that the cap arithmetic is struck at the 2027-12-10 close but the trade prints at the 2027-12-17 close, and the drift between them moves the executed trade by a median 20% and a p90 71% of its priced size (ten mega-cap/sector pairs, 944 quarterly windows 1999-2026). THIS ENTRY IS THE RULE'S OWN ANSWER TO EXACTLY THAT WEDGE: if drift over the remaining two weeks of the quarter pushes a name back through 24% or a cohort back through 50%, the filing re-caps at the 12-30 test and prints the correction after the 12-31 close. IT IS CONDITIONAL AND USUALLY DOES NOT FIRE — the proposer makes no claim that it will in December 2027, and no weight measured in 2026 forecasts a 2027 breach. TWO CALENDAR FEATURES A TAKING LANE SHOULD NOT REDISCOVER THE HARD WAY: the test day 2027-12-30 and the effective day 2027-12-31 both sit inside the thinnest liquidity week of the year, and 2027-12-31 is a SIFMA-recommended bond early close with the Fed Board shut, so any forced print lands into a half-staffed tape — an E1-class execution note, not a trade. Low impact and market-structure only; proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
